DIV5.HEAD: PART 18—PREPARATION AND TRANSMITTAL OF DOCUMENTS GENERALLY

DIV8.HEAD: § 18.1 Original and copies required.
DIV8.P: Except as provided in § 19.2 of this subchapter for Executive orders and proclamations, each agency submitting a document to be filed and published in the Federal Register shall send an original and two duplicate originals or certified copies. 1 However, if the document is printed or processed on both sides, one of the copies sent by the agency must be a collated, single-sided copy.
